text:
The most likely fault is the cross-coupled NMOS pair in the regenerative latch. M3 is 0.42 µm while its partner M4 is 0.994 µm, about 2.4× larger. Every other matched pair in the netlist is equal: M1/M2, M5/M6, M7/M8 and M9/M10. The mismatch gives the latch a built-in offset far larger than the ±2 mV input, so it resolves the same way regardless of input, which matches correct = 0. Because the mismatch is in the regeneration devices, the sensitivity sweep of the input pair and output inverters shows no change. Restoring M4 (or M3) to match its partner is the fix. The output polarity also looks inverted (vinp > vinn drives outp low), so that should be checked as well.
